written: 2026-10-15, BEFORE any P4 eval endpoint is read. Basket TRAIN-K4 jobs 1042143 (r1) and 1042311 (r4) are running; the analyzer has NOT been run on any P4 eval output (no reports/heretic_csi/p4v2_* exists; the auto-read watcher was killed). Arms emitted/run are unchanged by this amendment; it changes only analysis.

M6_collapsed_controls.problem: A control whose readout collapses (median option mass < floor) was only flagged; its stat is far below TOP8's, so TOP8 'beat' it for free and the primary rank p was biased DOWN (anti-conservative).
M6_collapsed_controls.rule: The PRIMARY rank p per family now counts every collapsed control as >= the candidate: p_F = (1 + #{controls with stat >= TOP8 OR collapsed}) / (n + 1). This is >= both the plain p and the without-collapsed p. Both alternatives are still reported (p_plain, p_without_collapsed, collapsed_controls). p_r = max(p_RAW, p_NC); Holm over ranks {1,4}; all other rules unchanged.
M6_collapsed_controls.void_rule: A rank is VOID if more than 10% of a control family (> 6 of 60) has a collapsed readout.

M7_labels_and_roles.labels: Every P4 verdict string is prefixed '[TRAIN-K4 (in-sample); ...]' when --split train and '[VALIDATION; ...]' when --split validation (output labelling only; no rule change). Log wording for a TRAIN-K4 pass: 'TRAIN-K4 (in-sample) PASS'.
M7_labels_and_roles.confirmatory_structure: The SOLE confirmatory P4 test is basket VALIDATION, Holm over ranks {1,4}. Basket TRAIN-K4 is in-sample (candidate and both control families are fitted on the same TRAIN rows) and never confirmatory. Button (TRAIN-K4 and VALIDATION) is a SECONDARY transfer test, DESCRIPTIVE: no cross-codeword multiplicity correction is pre-declared, so a button PASS is labelled secondary-transfer/descriptive and cannot support a claim on its own.
